sentences.en: And so if I, if I'm working on like one file, let's say, and I realized some other change needs
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我正在处理一个文件，比方说，我意识到在该文件中需要进行其他更改，

sentences.en: to be made within that file to like the same place that the current, you know, chat, the current agent is working in.

sentences.zh: 我记得有一次我的待办事项列表里有 14 件事，通常我会去创建 14 个不同的问题，然后一个接一个地关闭它们。

sentences.en: But I was just like, so it's, it's so funny that you're saying you used to use issues and now you just use like a to-do liSt. Cause that's

sentences.en: It's a waste of time to go set these things up cause you can, you can basically fix them and add features so quickly.

sentences.zh: 我只是把它们排进 Cursor 本身里。

sentences.en: One of the nice things is, is with the cursor chat, if it's working on a prompt, you can send a follow-up and the way that it works is it has a queue.
sentences.zh: 其中一个好处是，使用 Cursor 聊天时，如果它正在处理一个提示词，你可以发送后续指令，它的工作方式是有一个队列。

sentences.en: And so by default, if you, if you type something while it's working on something, you press enter, it doesn't send it to the agent immediately by default.
sentences.zh: 所以默认情况下，如果你在它处理某事时输入内容并按下回车，它不会立即发送给代理。

sentences.en: It puts it into this little queue.
sentences.zh: 它会放入这个小队列中。

sentences.en: And then once the agent has finished its current prompt, then it will send whatever the next thing is in the queue in the same chat session.
sentences.zh: 一旦代理完成了当前的提示词，它就会在同一个聊天会话中发送队列中的下一件事。

sentences.en: But there is also a button for called send now.
sentences.zh: 但也有一个叫“立即发送”的按钮。

sentences.en: So you can press that and that will send the message immediately.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以按下那个按钮，它会立即发送消息。

sentences.en: And so if you're watching what it's doing and you see in its thinking trace that it's like going off in the wrong direction, you can
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在观察它的工作，看到它的思考轨迹显示它正朝着错误的方向发展，你可以

sentences.zh: 立即给它发送一条消息，比如，“噢，别那样做”。

sentences.en: And I, and I do do that, you know, every, every now and then where I'm like, oh, you're heading in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 我确实会那样做，你知道，偶尔我会觉得，“噢，你走错方向了”。

sentences.en: Like, don't do that, do this instead.
sentences.zh: “别那样做，做这个。”

sentences.zh: 但我经常做的是，正如我之前所说，有时你正在处理一个项目或处理一个特定的任务。

sentences.en: And then you notice that there's something else related, like in the same place.
sentences.zh: 然后你注意到有其他相关的事情，比如在同一个地方。

sentences.en: And so what I'll often do is if I notice that while it's working on something, I'll just put the follow-up thing in the same chat and I'll queue up a couple of them.
sentences.zh: 所以我经常做的是，如果我在它工作时注意到这一点，我会把后续的事情放在同一个聊天中，并排队处理几个。

sentences.en: And like those, I don't even, I don't even write down those to do's.

sentences.en: I, I, I am a little cautious about doing that because I don't want to like, you know, I don't
sentences.zh: 我这样做有点谨慎，因为我不想，你知道，我不想

sentences.zh: 在早期，比如去年我刚开始使用 Cursor 时，我想大概是去年春天，也许更早。

sentences.en: I noticed I would, I would very frequently create a new chat because as the chats got longer performance of cursor itself got worse,
sentences.zh: 我注意到我非常频繁地创建新聊天，因为随着聊天记录变长，Cursor 本身的性能会变差，

sentences.en: Like I've told it to do, you know, like, like I've told it to like do some task and I want to tell it to like extend or, or, or fix something like related to like some
sentences.zh: 比如我已经告诉它做某项任务，我想告诉它扩展或修复与某个

sentences.en: If I'm in a new chat, I can't tell it just like, Oh, go add, like, like go at, or let me give a better example.
sentences.zh: 如果我在新聊天中，我不能只告诉它，“噢，去添加……”，或者让我举个更好的例子。

sentences.en: Let's say that I'm like modifying some function to add a new parameter to the function.
sentences.zh: 假设我正在修改某个函数以添加一个新参数。

sentences.zh: 我不需要解释更多。

sentences.en: I don't have to give it as much context.

sentences.zh: 而且在大上下文导致它困惑的问题上，我遇到的情况也少了。
